snippet.title: Knight Rider™ K.I.T.T. Construction Kit
snippet.description:
All new construction kits available now! Just like Michael Knight, you can summon a sleek, black, customized car with this brand new construction kit. Fight for law and justice with Knight’s Industries Two Thousand-or KITT karts, 1:1.2 & 1:1:8 scale scenery pieces, special FX pieces and more! Keep your scanners peeled in Planet Coaster today!
